# @boostengine/seo — AI Agent Manifest

## Summary
Industry-king eCommerce SEO & AI Agent Engine. Zero-dependency TypeScript library for JSON-LD structured data, Google Merchant Center feeds, Next.js metadata, sitemaps, robots.txt, SEO auditing, and AI function-calling tools.

## Exports
- `.` → Core engine: JSON-LD generators, Merchant feeds, Sitemaps, Robots.txt, Metadata, SEO Audit
- `./react` → React hooks & components: `<SEOProvider>`, `<JsonLdScript>`, `useProductJsonLd`, `useBreadcrumbJsonLd`, `useMetaTags`
- `./ai` → AI function-calling tools: `allAITools`, `findTool`, `executeToolCall`, `toOpenAIFunctions`, `toAnthropicTools`

## Core Functions (from `@boostengine/seo`)
- `generateProductJsonLd(product)` → Product schema with Offer, AggregateRating, Review, MerchantReturnPolicy, ShippingDetails
- `generateBreadcrumbJsonLd(items)` → BreadcrumbList schema
- `generateFaqJsonLd(faqs)` → FAQPage schema
- `generateHowToJsonLd(name, desc, steps, totalTime?)` → HowTo schema
- `generateArticleJsonLd(article)` → Article schema
- `generateOrganizationJsonLd(org)` → Organization schema
- `generateLocalBusinessJsonLd(biz)` → LocalBusiness schema
- `generateItemListJsonLd(items, listType?)` → ItemList schema
- `generateMerchantFeed(store, products)` → Google Merchant Center RSS 2.0 XML
- `generateSitemapXml(entries)` → XML sitemap with image extensions
- `generateRobotsTxt(options)` → robots.txt content
- `generateNextMetadata(product, options)` → Next.js Metadata object
- `auditPageSEO(input)` → SEO audit score 0-100 with recommendations

## AI Tools (from `@boostengine/seo/ai`)
- `generate_jsonld_schema` — Generate JSON-LD for any entity type
- `generate_merchant_feed` — Create Google Merchant XML feed
- `optimize_meta_tags` — Generate high-CTR title & description
- `generate_sitemap_xml` — Build XML sitemaps
- `audit_page_seo` — Automated SEO audit

## React Components (from `@boostengine/seo/react`)
- `<SEOProvider value={...}>{children}</SEOProvider>` — SEO context provider
- `<JsonLdScript schema={...} id="..." />` — JSON-LD script injector
- `useSEO()` → SEO context value
- `useProductJsonLd(product)` → Reactive product JSON-LD
- `useBreadcrumbJsonLd(items)` → Reactive breadcrumb JSON-LD
- `useMetaTags(meta)` → Client-side head meta updater

## CLI Commands
```
npx @boostengine/seo demo
npx @boostengine/seo audit --url <url>
npx @boostengine/seo generate-jsonld --type <type>
npx @boostengine/seo merchant-feed --input <file>
```
